test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct option to rearrange the following sentences:

A. His voice cracked as he addressed the crowd.

B. The room was filled with faces of people he once knew.

C. Not all were welcoming.

D. But he had something important to say.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins with **Sentence B**, which sets the scene by describing the room filled with familiar faces.
 
• **Sentence A follows** as he begins to speak, showing his nervousness through his cracked voice.
 
• **Sentence C comes next**, adding tension by highlighting that not everyone was welcoming.
 
• **Sentence D concludes** the paragraph, emphasizing his resolve to deliver an important message despite the atmosphere.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is **BACD**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The room was filled with faces of people he once knew. His voice cracked as he addressed the crowd. Not all were welcoming. But he had something important to say."
